applied_revisions.value: For the native executed prefix, let T_exec,m be the number of time steps selected by E_m and index them by u; the scalar training objective is L_train = (1/(T_exec,m * |J_m|)) * sum_{u=1}^{T_exec,m} sum_{j in J_m} (((y_tilde[Q|Q,m,k,u,j] - y_tilde[BF16|Q,m,k,u,j]) / s[m,j])^2), retaining every native prefix step.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Defined L_train as a scalar mean over the full native executed prefix and selected action channels.

applied_revisions.value: For each matched contrast, keep the same model-specific training and evaluation data split and deployment scope, and compare arms under a common total measured training GPU-time budget or, when compute is matched by solver calls, matched total teacher and student NFE; report total GPU-time, separate teacher/student NFEs, examples and unique-context exposure, repeated exposure, and optimizer updates so differences remain visible. Count 'vanilla action-only QAT plus teacher KD' and 'teacher KD at teacher states x_FP[m,k]' as one arm whenever their objective and targets are identical. For shared-backbone per-step OPD, define the loss with an action-only output mask over controller-selected action channels and prefix steps, with no video-output loss, and label it action-targeted shared-backbone training; any joint video-plus-action loss is a separately named arm with its own cost and scope.
applied_revisions.delta_summary: Specified matched training-cost accounting, coalesced duplicate teacher-state KD labels, and fixed shared-backbone OPD to an action-only output mask.
